A quote and explanation of the panels to be used was enough to convince us. We now have a 4.12kw system and can't wait for summer to start pumping out the juice. Cannot recommend Matthew and his team high enough. Totally trustworthy and honest. Will not sell you a dud system.

Mathew Devitt co-owner of Greenlife Solar sold us this solar system: a German SMS inverter and good quality panels. Unlike many pushy sales people from other companies, Mathew was informed, genuine and spent time at our house to make sure we got the right system. He was also prompt and attended appointment times on time. The same can be said for the installers who are not subcontracted but work for the same company. They were on time, professional, efficient, and clean and the installation was done without any hassles. During the process of approval, Mathew communicated by phone or email and responded to all my questions quickly so that I always knew what was happening. Paperwork to the appropriate authorities was carried out efficiently. At the completion of the job he came down and checked that we were completely satisfied. The panels and inverter all look very nice. I was happy with Greenlife Solar and cannot recommend them highly enough. I was particularity happy with Mathew who was direct, transparent and honest in his dealings with us. A great company!
